hooks.name: circuit-doctor
hooks.command: p=$(for c in "${CIRCUIT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/plugins/circuit" "${HOME:-}/.agents/plugins/circuit" "${HOME:-}/.openhands/plugins/installed/circuit"; do [ -f "$c/scripts/circuit_launcher.py" ] && printf %s "$c" && break; done); [ -n "$p" ] || { echo "circuit plugin root unresolved" >&2; exit 1; }; exec python3 "$p/scripts/circuit_launcher.py" doctor --warn
